subject: Business Management
examFormat: Two papers taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has fifty compulsory multiple-choice questions covering the entire syllabus (30 marks, 1 hour). Paper 2 has a compulsory case study of 200-250 words (25 marks) and seven essay questions of which candidates answer any three (15 marks each), for a total of 70 marks.

subtopics.name: Meaning and Process of Management
objectives: Explain the meaning of management and administration
State the basic functions of management
Identify the levels of management
Identify the types and roles of managers
Distinguish between administration and management

subtopics.name: Forms of Business Organization
objectives: Explain the meaning of business organization
Identify the major forms: sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability company, public corporations and co-operative society
State the procedures for formation, characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of each form
Identify the causes of business failure

subtopics.name: Business and Society
objectives: Explain the meaning of business environment
Identify the forces in the business environment
Explain the ethical, legal and social responsibilities of businesses
Distinguish primary from secondary stakeholders
State the responsibilities of businesses towards stakeholders

subtopics.name: Planning and Decision Making
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of planning
State the steps in planning, the types of planning and the limitations to planning
Explain the meaning and importance of decision making
State the steps in the decision making process
Distinguish programmed from non-programmed decisions
Identify the levels of management decisions

subtopics.name: Organizing
objectives: Explain the meaning, importance and activities of organizing
State the principles of organizing and explain organizational structure and organizational chart
Explain centralization and decentralization: meaning, differences, advantages and disadvantages
Explain the meaning and benefits of delegation
State the reasons why managers do not delegate and why subordinates do not accept delegation
State the guidelines for delegation

subtopics.name: Directing
objectives: Explain the meaning and elements of directing
Explain motivation: meaning, intrinsic and extrinsic factors
Explain Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs
Explain leadership and the importance of good leadership
Identify leadership styles and sources of power available to leaders
Explain communication: meaning, importance, formal and informal channels
Describe the communication process
Identify the barriers to communication
State the guidelines to effective communication

subtopics.name: Controlling
objectives: Explain the meaning of and reasons for controlling
State the steps in controlling
Identify the tools for controlling

topics.name: Management Information Technology
objectives: Explain the concept of ICT
Explain data and information, their differences, and the sources of business information
State the functions of the computer
Identify the applications of computers in business
State the advantages and challenges of the use of computers in business

subtopics.name: Law of Contract
objectives: Explain the meaning and elements of contract
Classify contracts
Explain vitiating factors (void and voidable contracts)
State the ways of discharging a contract

subtopics.name: Principles of Agency
objectives: Explain the creation of agency
State the rights and duties of a principal
State the rights and duties of an agent
Explain the termination of agency

subtopics.name: Negotiable Instruments
objectives: Explain the meaning and characteristics of negotiable instruments
Identify the types of negotiable instruments (cheques, bills of exchange, promissory notes)
State the classes, types, advantages and disadvantages of cheques and the ways of avoiding cheque frauds

subtopics.name: Money
objectives: Explain the meaning and characteristics of money
State the functions of money
Explain the meaning and causes of inflation

subtopics.name: Banking
objectives: Identify the types of banks
State the functions of the Central bank
State the functions of commercial and other types of banks
Identify the types of bank accounts
Identify the tools of monetary control

subtopics.name: Risk Management and Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of risk and risk management
Identify the types of business risks
Explain the meaning and importance of insurance
State the principles of insurance
Identify the types of insurance and insurance policies

subtopics.name: Stock Exchange
objectives: Explain the meaning and functions of the stock exchange
Identify the types of securities

topics.name: Role of Government in the Economy
objectives: Explain the role of government in an economy
Identify the sources and types of government revenue
State the purpose of taxation
Identify the types of taxes and the challenges of tax collection
Identify the types and items of government expenditure

topics.name: International Trade and Problems of Developing Economies

subtopics.name: International Trade
objectives: Explain the meaning of trade
Distinguish domestic from international trade
Identify the documents used in domestic and international trade
State the reasons for international trade
Explain the theories of absolute cost and comparative cost advantage
Identify restrictions in international trade
Explain Balance of Payments (BOP) and measures for correcting BOP deficit

subtopics.name: Developing Economies
objectives: Identify the challenges of developing economies in relation to international trade
State the ways of improving developing economies by government
State the role of the IMF, IBRD and UNCTAD in international trade

subtopics.name: Globalization
objectives: Explain the meaning and causes of globalization
State the advantages and disadvantages of globalization

subtopics.name: Economic integration
objectives: Explain the meaning of economic integration
State the roles of ECOWAS, the African Union (AU), the European Union (EU), the African Caribbean Pacific (ACP) countries and ASEAN in economic integration

subtopics.name: Elements of Human Resource Management
objectives: Explain the meaning and functions of human resource management
State the steps in the recruitment and selection process
Identify the sources of recruitment
Identify the types of training
Explain job analysis (job description and job specification)
Explain the meaning and importance of performance appraisal

subtopics.name: Labour Relations
objectives: Explain the meaning of labour relations, trade unions and industrial relations
State the functions of trade unions
Explain the meaning and functions of employers' associations
Explain collective bargaining: process, importance and rights of parties involved

subtopics.name: Fundamentals of Production Management
objectives: Explain the meaning of production and production management
Identify the forms of production: extractive, manufacturing, construction, commercial and personal services
Identify the factors of production
Explain the meaning of specialization and exchange
State the advantages and disadvantages of specialization
Identify the types of production process: job, batch, flow
State the steps in production planning and control

subtopics.name: Principles of Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning and activities of marketing
Explain market segmentation: meaning and bases
Identify the elements of the marketing mix (product, price, promotion and place)
State the steps in new product development
Describe the stages of the product life cycle (introduction, growth, maturity and decline)
State the functions of packaging and the uses of branding
Identify the factors affecting pricing and pricing objectives
Explain promotion: meaning, importance and types
Identify channels of distribution
State the functions of wholesalers and retailers

subtopics.name: Electronic Commerce (e-Commerce)
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of e-commerce

subtopics.name: Business Finance
objectives: Explain the meaning of business finance
Identify short-term and long-term sources of finance
Identify government lending programmes and venture capital fund

subtopics.name: Entrepreneurship
objectives: Explain the meaning of entrepreneurship
State the role of entrepreneurs
State the characteristics of an entrepreneur
State the content of a business plan
State the reasons for business successes and failures
Explain record keeping: meaning, importance and types
Explain time management: meaning, importance and techniques

subtopics.name: Small Business
objectives: Explain the meaning and categories of small businesses
State the procedures in the formation of small businesses
State the importance of small businesses in the economy
Identify the challenges of small businesses
State the role of government in promoting small businesses
State the ways of sustaining an established business
